name: Automated Street Sweeper
description: An autonomous street-cleaning vehicle that roams Tier 2-4 districts between midnight and 6 AM. In the higher tiers, they're efficient and invisible. In Tier 2 districts, they're the only municipal service that actually shows up regularly, and residents have developed an odd fondness for them. Each sweeper has been given an unofficial name by the neighborhood it serves. Tier 1 districts don't get sweepers. The streets there are cleaned by rain and resignation.
autonomy: Fully autonomous, obstacle avoidance, route optimization
armament: None. Pressurized water jets for cleaning (creative secondary uses exist).
common_usage: Street cleaning, waste collection, urban maintenance.
story_hooks: A street sweeper in a Tier 2 district has been collecting something other than garbage — its waste hopper contains items arranged in deliberate patterns
When a sweeper is finally assigned to a Tier 1 block as a pilot program, the residents treat it like a celebrity and its removal sparks a protest
